query_facts.operation: INSERT INTO availability_history from mapped staged-price input
query_facts.confirmed_by: the benchmark exception retained the complete parameter-redacted SQL after the targeted backend termination
query_facts.interpretation: The fresh-schema transaction had usable staged-price statistics but no planner statistics for the permanent retailer-item and store rows inserted earlier in the same transaction. The repeatedly expanded mapped-input join was CPU-bound; the standard 1,000,000-row profile was not started pending materialization and analysis of that projection.

environment.storage: dedicated MakoletBenchmark WSL2 ext4 filesystem on E: with 955 GiB free before the run

termination.method: pg_terminate_backend limited to PID 68 with application_name makolet-scale-benchmark in database makolet_benchmark
termination.reason: the first availability-history insert remained CPU-active for more than 13 minutes at 100,000 unique mapped records
termination.rollback: connection termination rolled back the active initial-apply transaction
termination.schema_cleanup: BenchmarkSandbox finally block dropped only schema makolet_benchmark

unmeasured: full-scale query and apply EXPLAIN plans
